_doc: ARC §2.5 Decision card + §1.4 Hearts layer/inspector on the §6.7 stub, lookdev world ('homestead' POI town), 888x500 with UI. Run: setsid nohup _harness/slot.sh node _harness/shots.mjs _harness/arc-work/specs/ui-decision.json --port=5311 > _harness/scratch/arc/shots-decision.log 2>&1 & Each script ends with G.hold(true) so page.screenshot composites the last frame instead of waiting minutes for a new one.

shots.name: arc-decision-card
script: const p = G.poi('homestead'); const pv = F.fx.vis.pv; let host = -1, bd = 1e9, near = -1, bn = 1e9; for (const s of pv.settlements) { const d = Math.hypot(s.pos[0]-p.pos[0], s.pos[1]-p.pos[1], s.pos[2]-p.pos[2]); if (d < bd) { bn = bd; near = host; bd = d; host = s.id; } else if (d < bn) { bn = d; near = s.id; } }
window.__host = host; window.__near = near; window.__p = p;

G.arc.stub('towers', [{ id: 7, pos: p.pos, cell: p.cell, name: 'the Tower of Kel-Amar', host, league: near >= 0 ? [host, near] : [host], height: 38, goal: 80, tiers: 4, material: 'mudbrick', style: 2, status: 'rising', builders: 9, begun: 0, ended: -1, answer: 'none', choiceOpen: true, canAnswer: ['confuse', 'strike', 'warn', 'let'] }]);

const H = (kind, o) => Object.assign({ kind, proud: false, devoted: 0.1, fearful: 0.1, restless: 0.1, defiant: 0, pride: 0.3, defiance: 0.1, dusk: 0.3, duskYearAgo: 0.6, caption: '', line: '', remember: [], answered: '' }, o);

G.arc.stub('hearts', [{ settlement: host, heart: H('fearful', { fearful: 0.52, proud: true, pride: 0.68, caption: 'They watch the sky', line: 'In this town they watch the sky and speak quietly.', remember: ['the storm that took the harvest'] }) }].concat(near >= 0 ? [{ settlement: near, heart: H('defiant', { defiant: 0.41, defiance: 0.55, caption: 'They raise their fists' }), defiant: { kind: 'curse', tick: 1 } }] : []));
await G.camera({ mode: 'orbit', lat: p.lat, lon: p.lon, dist: 600, tilt: 60, yaw: p.heading + 25, fov: 50, hour: 10 }); await G.frames(12);

const __r = { host, near, decision: G.arc.decision(), card: r ? [r.left, r.top, r.width, r.height].map(Math.round) : null, chips: document.querySelectorAll('.gn-slabel-heart').length }; G.hold(true); return __r;

shots.name: arc-decision-insp
script: G.hold(false); G.select({ kind: 'settlement', id: window.__host }); await G.frames(12);

const __r = { card: r ? [r.left, r.top, r.width, r.height].map(Math.round) : null, insp: q ? [q.left, q.top, q.width, q.height].map(Math.round) : null, cls: document.querySelector('.gn-decision')?.className }; G.hold(true); return __r;

shots.name: arc-decision-pill
script: G.hold(false); G.select(null); G.arc.later(); G.ui_.overlay('hearts'); await G.camera({ mode: 'orbit', lat: __p.lat, lon: __p.lon, dist: 2400, tilt: 35, yaw: __p.heading + 25, fov: 50, hour: 11 }); await G.frames(20);

const __r = { pill: r ? [r.left, r.top, r.width, r.height].map(Math.round) : null, decision: G.arc.decision(), legend: document.querySelector('.gn-legend')?.textContent?.slice(0, 120) }; G.hold(true); return __r;
